discoveries.text: Real decisions.md stores have three decision-line shapes: `## D7 *default*: …` headings (voice-concierge), `- **D1 · …**` bullets (rane-one-mixxx), `| D24 | … |` table rows (dj-crate-streaming); M3-04's parser and fixtures cover all three.

pack CLI must read CLAUDE.md and the decisions store only when the run dir sits at <wt>/.harness/runs/<run>; tests/checks/12 calls `pack` on $T/pk and $T/jr/legacy, whose third parent is outside the throwaway tree.
Gotchas-step text cannot use {{RUN}} (no such prompt variable); the run id is on the `Run:` line under *This run*.

questions: Promote to Gotchas is in coding packs only (a verify cannot write CLAUDE.md), and a project raising CONTEXT_PACK_BYTES above 16384 does not raise the verify cap: OK as defaults?
